about_lead: Local code validation for any stack: the plan is reviewed first and the result stays tied to the code that was analyzed.
about_docs_note: The interface works without a network, so the documentation is given as a path inside the project repository.
about_updates_note: JGates never checks on its own. Pressing the button asks the JGates repository on GitHub for its newest version; nothing else is sent.
about_updates_state_unknown: This build does not say which commit it came from; installing the newest one is safe
about_updates_manual_clone: This JGates runs from a clone ({packageDir}). To update it: git pull, then npm install and npm run build in that folder.
about_updates_manual_global: A global npm install cannot be updated from here. Clone the repository, run npm install and npm pack in it, then npm install --global ./jgates-<version>.tgz.
about_updates_manual_dependency: Run jgates update in a terminal.
about_updates_confirm_text: This runs the command below on this machine. It downloads and builds the new version, which takes a few minutes.
about_updates_restart: Close this tab and run jgates ui again to open the new version. If you use the quality sidecar image, rebuild it from a clone.
about_updates_failed_note: npm ended with exit {code}. The previous version stays installed.
